products.name: Business Loan
products.shortDescription: Flexible business loans to scale your enterprise with DigitalDSA
products.linkTitle: DigitalDSA Business Loan - Empower Your Growth
products.linkDescription: Access tailored business loans through DigitalDSA to meet your expansion needs.

options.title: Eligibility
options.description: Business operational for 2+ years, turnover ₹10 lakhs+, CIBIL 650+.

options.title: Interest Rates
options.description: 11.5% to 25% p.a., based on CIBIL and financials (e.g., SBI: 11.5% for 800+, RBL: 25% for 650-699).

options.title: Loan Amount
options.description: ₹5,00,000 to ₹50,00,000, based on business needs and repayment capacity.

options.title: Tenure
options.description: 12 to 60 months, aligned with cash flow requirements.

options.title: Documents Required
options.description: Business registration, GST returns, ITR for 2 years, 6 months' bank statements, KYC of proprietors/directors.

faq.question: What's the processing fee for a DigitalDSA Business Loan?
faq.answer: 1.5% to 4% of the loan amount + GST, depending on the lender (e.g., HDFC: up to 4%, SBI: up to 4%).

faq.question: Are collateral-free business loans available?
faq.answer: Yes, unsecured options through partners like HDFC and ICICI, with higher rates.

faq.question: How long does approval take?
faq.answer: Approval within 48 hours with complete documentation.

products.name: Loan Against Property (LAP)
products.shortDescription: Unlock property value with DigitalDSA's LAP offerings
products.linkDescription: Get funds against your residential or commercial property with DigitalDSA's LAP solutions.

options.title: Eligibility
options.description: Ages 21-70, own a residential/commercial property, CIBIL 650+.

options.title: Interest Rates
options.description: 9.75% to 17% p.a., based on CIBIL and property value (e.g., Standard Chartered: 9.75% for 800+, Bajaj: 17% for 650-699).

options.title: Loan Amount
options.description: Up to 60% of property value or ₹50 lakhs, depending on valuation.

options.title: Tenure
options.description: 5 to 15 years, based on partner bank policies.

options.title: Documents Required
options.description: ID proof, address proof, property title deeds, income proof, 6 months' bank statements.

faq.question: What properties can I use for a DigitalDSA LAP?
faq.answer: Residential and commercial properties accepted (e.g., HDFC, SBI support both; Bajaj only residential).

faq.question: What's the processing fee for LAP?
faq.answer: Up to 1% of the loan amount + GST (e.g., Axis: up to 1%, South Indian: up to 1%).

products.name: Plot Loan
products.shortDescription: Finance your land purchase with DigitalDSA's plot loans
products.linkTitle: DigitalDSA Plot Loan - Secure Your Land
products.linkDescription: Buy your dream plot with DigitalDSA's affordable financing options.

options.title: Interest Rates
options.description: 8.25% to 15% p.a., based on CIBIL (e.g., Shinhan: 8.25% for 800+, Bajaj: 15% for 650-699).

options.title: Loan Amount
options.description: Up to 70% of plot value or ₹50 lakhs, based on eligibility.

options.title: Tenure
options.description: 5 to 35 years, depending on partner bank (e.g., Bajaj: up to 35 years, HDFC: 15 years).

options.title: Documents Required
options.description: ID proof, address proof, income proof, plot documents, 6 months' bank statements.

faq.question: Can I get a plot loan for agricultural land?
faq.answer: Select partners like SBI and South Indian Bank offer agricultural plot loans with specific conditions.

faq.question: What's the processing fee for plot loans?
faq.answer: 0.5% to 1% of the loan amount + GST, varying by partner bank.

generalFaq.question: What banks does DigitalDSA partner with?
generalFaq.answer: We partner with leading banks including HDFC, SBI, ICICI, Axis, Bajaj Finserv, and more for comprehensive loan solutions.

generalFaq.question: How does the application process work?
generalFaq.answer: Submit your application online, upload required documents, and receive approval within 48 hours. Our team guides you throughout.

generalFaq.question: What credit score is needed?
generalFaq.answer: Most loans require a minimum CIBIL score of 650+. Higher scores (700+) qualify for better interest rates.

generalFaq.question: How long does disbursement take?
generalFaq.answer: Post-approval, disbursement typically happens within 24-72 hours, depending on the loan type and bank.
